basic.name: Soul Rip
basic.description: Extract the souls of nearby enemies afflicted by Reaper's Mark, dealing 100~~0.04~~ damage and healing Malthael for 25~~0.04~~ per target hit. Heroic targets heal Malthael for an additional 4% of the Hero's maximum Health.

basic.name: Wraith Strike
basic.description: Instantly teleport through an enemy afflicted by Reaper's Mark, dealing 59~~0.04~~ damage and refreshing Reaper's Mark.

basic.name: Death Shroud
basic.description: After 0.25 seconds, unleash a wave of dark mist that applies Reaper's Mark to enemies it hits.

heroic.name: Tormented Souls
heroic.description:
Unleash a torrent of souls, continually applying Reaper's Mark to nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Tormented Souls resets the cooldown of Wraith Strike when activated, and while active, Wraith Strike costs no Mana its cooldown is reduced to 2 seconds.

heroic.name: Last Rites
heroic.description:
Apply a death sentence to an enemy Hero that, after 2 seconds, deals damage equal to 50% of their missing Health.

Quest: Enemies killed between the application of Last Rites and within 1.5 seconds of it dealing damage permanently reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds, to a minimum of 20 seconds.

trait.name: Reaper's Mark
trait.description: Basic Attacks cleave in an area in front of Malthael and afflict non-Structure targets with Reaper's Mark for 4 seconds. Marked enemies are revealed and take damage equal to 2% of their maximum Health every 1 second.

activable.name: Fear the Reaper
activable.description: Activate to increase Movement Speed by 25% and pass through other units for 4 seconds.

activable.name: Touch of Death
activable.description: Activate to reduce healing received by Heroes afflicted by Reaper's Mark by 50% for 4 seconds.

activable.name: Inevitable End
activable.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds, but remove all active Reaper's Marks.

activable.name: Shroud of Wisdom
activable.description: After 2 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor for 4 seconds.

activable.name: No One Can Stop Death
activable.description: Activate while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms but increase Malthael's next respawn time by 25%.

level1.name: On a Pale Horse
level1.description: Gain an additional 20% Movement Speed while mounted.

level1.name: Fear the Reaper
level1.description: Activate to increase Movement Speed by 25% and pass through other units for 4 seconds.

level4.name: Die Alone
level4.description: Soul Rip deals 50% more damage to Heroes if it hits only one Hero.

level4.name: Throwing Shade
level4.description:
Increase Death Shroud's range by 33%, reduce its cooldown by 3 seconds, and reduce its Mana cost from 50 to 30.

Death Shroud's initial impact deals 2% maximum Health as damage to non-Structure enemies.

level4.name: Black Harvest
level4.description:
Quest: Apply Reaper's Mark to Heroes for a total of 150 seconds.

Reward: Permanently increase Reaper's Mark's duration by 2 seconds.

level7.name: Cold Hand
level7.description: Soul Rip Slows enemies by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

level7.name: Massacre
level7.description: Wraith Strike now damages and applies Reaper's Mark to enemies around its target.

level7.name: Touch of Death
level7.description: Activate to reduce healing received by Heroes afflicted by Reaper's Mark by 50% for 4 seconds.

Tormented Souls resets the cooldown of Wraith Strike when activated, and while active, Wraith Strike costs no Mana its cooldown is reduced to 2 seconds.

level13.name: Soul Siphon
level13.description: Increase Soul Rip's bonus healing from Heroes to 4.75% of the Hero's maximum Health.

level13.name: Ethereal Existence
level13.description: Gain 10 Physical Armor per enemy Hero afflicted by Reaper's Mark, up to a maximum of 30.

level13.name: Inevitable End
level13.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds, but remove all active Reaper's Marks.

level13.name: Shroud of Wisdom
level13.description: After 2 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor for 4 seconds.

level16.name: Soul Collector
level16.description: Reduce Soul Rip's cooldown by 0.5 seconds and increase its range by 25%.

level16.name: Mortality
level16.description: When damaging a Hero, Wraith Strike deals bonus damage equal to 8% of the Hero's maximum Health.

level16.name: Memento Mori
level16.description: Reaper's Mark deals 60% increased damage after afflicting an enemy for more than 4 seconds.

level20.name: Reaper of Souls
level20.description:
Increase the duration of Tormented Souls to 6 seconds, and while Tormented Souls is active, Hero Takedowns refresh its duration.

If 2 or more enemy Heroes are in Tormented Souls' radius, it does not decay.

level20.name: Angel of Death
level20.description: Last Rites heals for 100% of the damage dealt, and its current and future cooldown reduction bonuses are doubled.

level20.name: Final Curtain
level20.description: Death Shroud leaves a trail in its wake for 4 seconds, applying Reaper's Mark to enemies in its area.

level20.name: No One Can Stop Death
level20.description: Activate while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms but increase Malthael's next respawn time by 25%.
